unlock.first_20_boundary: Explains why a living body does not automatically outrank proof, samples, salvage and quarantine in the same tonne-window.

metadata.truth_payload: A tonne-window body ledger turns living body, proof, sample, salvage and witness tags into competing recovery mass lines; rescue becomes real only when receiver, quarantine, proof priority and lift allocation agree.
metadata.player_question: Why can the route count a living body as cargo while proof leaves first?

en_US.title: Tonne-Window Body Ledger
en_US.scanner: MASS LINE READ // Living body detected. Body recovery pending receiver, quarantine berth, proof priority and lift allocation.
en_US.terminal: KEELMARK BODY LEDGER // 4.8 tonne-window active. Body, proof core, sample canister, salvage crate and witness tag currently share recovery mass pressure.
en_US.audio: Allocation note: body line alive, not cleared. Keep proof sealed. Do not spend ascent hardware until receiver and quarantine agree.
en_US.in_game_wiki: A tonne-window body ledger explains why a living Marauder does not automatically outrank every payload. Black Keel can hear a signal, price a body line and still hold recovery while proof, samples, salvage and quarantine fight for the same lift mass. Treat the ledger as evidence: receiver, contamination, proof priority and lift allocation must align before rescue is real.
en_US.external_site: A longform recovery-accounting primer on the cruel difference between being heard, being counted and being physically accepted through a tonne-window.
en_US.field_note: If the ledger calls you cargo, make it carry proof with the weight of a name.

ru_RU.in_game_wiki: Tonne-window body ledger объясняет, почему живой Marauder не получает автоматический приоритет над каждым payload. Black Keel может услышать signal, оценить body line и все равно держать recovery, пока proof, samples, salvage и quarantine спорят за одну lift mass. Читай ledger как evidence: receiver, contamination, proof priority и lift allocation должны совпасть, прежде чем rescue станет реальным.
ru_RU.external_site: Большой primer по recovery accounting: жесткая разница между тем, что тебя услышали, посчитали и физически приняли через tonne-window.
ru_RU.field_note: Если ledger зовет тебя cargo, заставь его нести proof с весом имени.
